pr.title: feat(cli): remind to run stk setup post-install
pr.body: Closes #42 - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add hints on what to do next (#56)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/56)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): remind to run stk setup post-install (#55)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/55)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add top/bottom commands (#54)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/54)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add rename command (#53)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/53)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): flip --delete-branch to --keep-branch in stk cleanup (#52)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/52)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: install-success-msg contains backticks, and the shell installer prints it as a shell literal, so `git stk setup` is command-substituted and actually run at install time.
